summary_en: Decree promulgating the editio typica of the Martyrologium Romanum restored by decree of the Second Vatican Council, approved by John Paul II and declared typical by the Congregation; in force as soon as published.
excerpt:
Prot. N. 551/00/L
DECRETUM
[...] Proinde hanc editionem Martyrologii Romani Summus Pontifex IOANNES PAULUS PP. II auctoritate sua apostolica approbavit et Congregatio de Cultu Divino et Disciplina Sacramentorum nunc promulgat atque typicam esse declarat. Ipsa editio, lingua latina exarata, statim ac prodierit vigere incipiet. [...] die 29 mensis iunii anni 2001, in sollemnitate Ss. Petri et Pauli, Apostolorum.

summary_en: Report of the Archbishop Secretary to the 2001 Plenary (not a decree): during preparation of the new Missale Romanum the Superior Authority ordered the addition of 11 celebrations to the General Roman Calendar - 3 Jan Most Holy Name of Jesus; 8 Feb St Josephine Bakhita; 13 May BVM of Fatima; 21 May Ss Christopher Magallanes and companions; 22 May St Rita of Cascia; 9 Jul Ss Augustine Zhao Rong and companions; 20 Jul St Apollinaris; 24 Jul St Sharbel Makhluf; 9 Aug St Teresa Benedicta of the Cross; 12 Sep Most Holy Name of Mary; 25 Nov St Catherine of Alexandria - and recalls the 1996 decision to add four optional memorials (Ss Adalbert, Peter Julian Eymard, Peter Claver, Louis Marie Grignion de Montfort) and raise the Immaculate Heart of Mary to an obligatory memorial. No protocol or date printed.
excerpt: Successivamente, nel corso dei lavori preparativi del nuovo Missale Romanum, l'Autorità Superiore ha disposto l'aggiunta di 11 celebrazioni: 3 ianuarii: SS.mi Nominis Iesu; 8 februarii: S. Iosephinae Bakhita, virginis; 13 maii: Beatae Mariae Virginis de Fatima; 21 maii: Ss. Christophori Magallanes, presbyteri, et sociorum, martyrum; 22 maii: S. Ritae de Cascia, religiosae; 9 iulii: Ss. Augustini Zhao Rong, presbyteri et sociorum, martyrum; 20 iulii: S. Apollinaris, episcopi et martyris; 24 iulii: S. Sarbelii Makhluf, presbyteri; 9 augusti: S. Teresiae Benedictae a Cruce, virginis et martyris; 12 septembris: SS.mi Nominis Mariae; 25 novembris: S. Catharinae Alexandrinae, virginis et martyris.
